CAB presents: Campus Yard Sale🏷️

Want to meet some of the amazing RSO’s on campus? 🏫

Come by to our annual Campus Yard Sale and learn more about the amazing student ran organizations that UCF has to offer! 🧾

✨Grab some free goodies and drinks (Apple Cider at the CAB table!!🍎), while supplies last! ✨

📆: Tuesday, October 13 at 12 p.m.
📍: Student Union Patio

💥 𝙎𝙄𝙂𝙉𝙄𝙉𝙂 𝙉𝙊𝙒 𝘼𝙏 𝘾𝘼𝙋𝘼𝘾𝙄𝙏𝙔! 𝗟𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘀𝗽𝗮𝗰𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝘆 𝗯𝗲 𝗮𝘃𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗼𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄… 💥 ⁣
⁣
Join us on 𝗦𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗢𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟭𝟭𝘁𝗵 @𝟭𝗽𝗺 for a special @sspu 𝗔𝗰𝗼𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗜𝗻-𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 (𝘄/ 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗻 & 𝗡𝗶𝗸𝗸𝗶) & 𝗙𝘂𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗦𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴! 🎶 🤩✍️ ⁣
⁣
🚨 𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧 𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗡𝗧 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗥𝗬:  We are now 𝗔𝗧 𝗖𝗔𝗣𝗔𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 and will no longer be taking orders for entry. Additional #FREE entry may be available for the 𝗮𝗰𝗼𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗶𝗻-𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 via our 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱-𝗯𝘆 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲, which will begin forming Sunday afternoon at 12PM. Entry via the stand-by line is 𝗡𝗢𝗧 𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗲𝗱; spots will be filled first come, first served! ✨⁣
⁣
𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧 𝗗𝗘𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗟𝗦:⁣
👉 Each purchase of an SSPU album will receive ONE WRISTBAND at check-in (day of the event) for ONE ENTRY to the SIGNING portion of the event. ⁣
👉 SSPU purchase can be picked up at check-in, day of the event.⁣
👉 ⁣SSPU will sign ONE ALBUM (purchased through PACDs) per person with a wristband. ⁣
⁣
📍Location: 2916 Corrine Drive, Orlando, FL 32803⁣⁠⁣
⁠✍️ Check-In: Sun. October 11th @ 12PM⁣⁠⁣
📆  Start Time: Sun. October 11th @ 1PM⁣⁠⁣
